name: scrapsathi-microservices
description: ScrapSaathi - Scalable Microservices Architecture for Scrap Pickup Marketplace & Recycling Ecosystem

scripts.start: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PICKUP,RATE,DONATION" -c "magenta,green,blue,yellow,cyan" "npm run start --prefix services/api-gateway" "npm run start --prefix services/auth-service" "npm run start --prefix services/pickup-service" "npm run start --prefix services/rate-service" "npm run start --prefix services/donation-service"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PICKUP,RATE,DONATION,FRONT" -c "magenta,green,blue,yellow,cyan,red" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:pickup" "npm run dev:rate" "npm run dev:donation" "npm run dev:frontend"

author: Aman Kumar, Pranav Raj
